author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
fingers lay bare
ripping flesh
of a once shared cantaloupe
now seeds spread
a gelatinous mess
in only one hand
viscid vicissitudes
drip from the mouth

half untouched
slices of
memories of time
unspent
he licks
fingers questioning
her intent
